summary: The filing is an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering by Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. The company issued 13.68M shares and 6.00M warrants with an exercise price of $5.481 per share to Hudson Bay Master Fund Ltd. at an aggregate price of $5.481 per unit. The offering was made under an existing S-3 shelf registration statement. There is no stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change beyond the capital raise. The filing is a routine takedown, not a special situation. Thus, it falls outside the defined special-situations categories.
